requirements: all rows share the train-only scalar gauge hash
the same normalization is applied to rJ and rE
train normalized rJ has absolute mean <= 1e-8 and absolute std_minus_one <= 1e-8
primary_gates.threshold_generation: exact contract; no empirical validation threshold

physical_scoring_mask.pass_even: set HbO and HbR observations to NaN jointly in patches 0,2,4,6,8 and score only those points
physical_scoring_mask.pass_odd: set HbO and HbR observations to NaN jointly in patches 1,3,5,7,9 and score only those points
physical_scoring_mask.merge: combine the masked-point predictions from the two passes to cover all 200 points exactly once

primary_gates.threshold_generation: for each masked-point metric max(0, 0.25 * subjects_01_18 subject-excluded-template median)
primary_gates.validation_rule: subject-cluster-bootstrap lower_95_ci > frozen_threshold and at least 4/5 subjects > frozen_threshold

primary_gates.physical_scoring_mask: identical fixed even/odd 2s patch-parity cross-fit registered for G2
primary_gates.threshold_generation: jointness minima are max(0, 0.25 * subjects_01_18 median); correction lower=max(0.01, train_subject_q10/2), upper=min(2.0, 2*train_subject_q90)
primary_gates.validation_rule: both jointness lower_95_ci exceed frozen minima; correction subject median lies strictly inside frozen interval; at least 4/5 subjects have nonzero finite correction

requirements: at least three additional perturbation bundles
no perturbation uses subjects_19_23 for fit, normalization, selection, or thresholding
sample-aligned validation rJ correlations are evaluated after each bundle's own train-only scalar gauge
primary_gates.threshold_generation: registered fixed minimum median subject correlation 0.70 and minimum worst-perturbation positive-subject count 4/5

primary_gates.subject_block_alignment: within each subject, rows are canonically ordered by session, condition, and zero-based within-cell rank obtained by sorting unique raw event_index values inside that subject/session/condition cell; raw event_index values need not match across subjects; all subjects must have the same session×condition cell set, cell counts, within-cell-rank layout, and target time shape
primary_gates.model_selection: ridge alpha selected by subjects_01_18 leave-one-subject-out cross-validation
primary_gates.threshold_generation: max(0, subjects_01_18 subject-block target-permutation q95 of subject-equal delta_R2); every permutation repeats the complete leave-one-subject-out procedure and alpha selection across all registered alpha candidates; for each held subject, target blocks are permuted only among the other 17 subjects and every ridge is refit
primary_gates.validation_rule: subject-cluster-bootstrap lower_95_ci > frozen threshold and at least 4/5 subjects > frozen threshold for both modalities

primary_gates.true_paired: use the fixed even/odd 2s parity masks; update only from unmasked original fNIRS points and score original heldout points
primary_gates.null_generation: for each train trial/parity, precompute the masked solver for all nine nonzero whole-patch circular shifts of the fNIRS update input; each of 2000 draws selects one common shift per subject×session×condition and aggregates the cached solver-equivalent heldout metrics
primary_gates.threshold_generation: subjects_01_18 null q95 with numpy higher order-statistic method for both level and within-heldout-patch first-difference gains
primary_gates.validation_rule: validation subject-equal level and within-patch first-difference gains both exceed frozen q95 and at least 4/5 subjects have positive null margin for both
primary_gates.interpretation: paired heldout measurement-update consistency with phase/temporal/smooth null exclusion; not independent causal physiological evidence
